selection: Current candidate for the user's pretrained-only, sub-100M fully on-chain agent; deployment target remains unmet.
weights: Original upstream weights for CPU smoke tests; publisher Q4_K_M and Q8_0 files for storage/compression assessment. No training, distillation or fine-tuning.
runtime_target: Fully on-chain tokenization, inference, memory and validated actions; offline export allowed, with an external transaction submitter.
stage: 497 four-bit weights/kernel/index contracts verified on RH, plus two historical pilots and one deployed prepaid inference runtime: 500 public contracts. The 35,852-byte runtime is byte-for-byte verified at 0x69996912a59a241763c71810193cf1021ddbb8c0. Full inference and escrow were validated locally; no paid mainnet chat has been sent. Frontend and executor integration, raw-text on-chain tokenization and validated agent actions remain incomplete.
quantization_status: Six custom low-bit variants tested against unchanged weights on CPU. No aggressive variant is accepted for production; deployment target remains unmet.
research_status: Research milestone; measured execution cost remains a major optimization target. Historical deployment fees and inference measurements are public.
